title: Canonical derived etale-Zariski comparison-square data
statement: For schemes $U,T$ [def-pc-scheme], with the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], a morphism $h:U\to T$, and derived etale-Zariski equivalence data $d_U,d_T$ [def-sfb-derived-etale-zariski-equivalence-data], define the type of canonical comparison-square witnesses as follows. Use the canonical Zariski/small-etale ringed-site module contexts with their restriction and tensor-extension functors [def-sfb-scheme-zariski-etale-module-constructions], and the small-etale structure-ring map and module direct image along $h$ [def-sfb-scheme-small-etale-module-direct-image], whose canonical tensor-pullback left adjoint is the ordinary small-etale pullback; unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [def-pc-derived-category], derived tensor pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], their fixed derived adjunction [def-sfb-canonical-scheme-derived-adjunction-composition], structure-module multiplication [def-sfb-tensor-pullback-structure-sheaf-map], and K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. The data consists of the ordinary small-etale pullback/direct-image adjunction and ordinary restriction square, whose components on opens are restriction along the canonical base-change identification; additive witnesses; left-derived etale pullback and its counit universal property, right-derived etale pushforward and its unit universal property computed on every K-injective, and their adjunction normalized by the ordinary Hom correspondence. Include the Zariski left-derived counit and its normalization for the fixed derived adjunction. Include a natural isomorphism $E_U\circ Lh^*\cong Lh_{\mathrm{et}}^*\circ E_T$, agreeing on homotopy representatives with the ordinary scalar-extension comparison and the left-derived counits. Require etale pullback to preserve quasi-coherent cohomology; etale direct image to preserve it when $h$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated; and the canonical unit--inverse-comparison--counit mate $E_T Rh_*\to Rh_{\mathrm{et},*}E_U$ to be invertible there. Quasi-coherent cohomology means [pqf-def-coherent] on the Zariski side and [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] on the small etale side, in every integer degree. Define the actual etale structure-module map by adjoint scalar multiplication; require it to be invertible, and require compatibility of both structure-module multiplication maps with the ordinary pullback comparison. The helper functors on complexes and homotopy categories are termwise ordinary etale pullback using the square additivity witness. This defines a type of witnesses, without asserting that it is inhabited.
